The Challenge

Slow Sales & Stuck Inventory

Gold Bellagio is Kota's most premium residential offering — but the ultra-luxury segment in a Tier-2 city comes with a unique challenge. Despite a superior product, the project was struggling to convert interest into visits. The real problem ran deeper: with their previous digital marketing team, bulk leads were coming in — but the quality was so poor that not a single site visit had been generated. High ticket size, a completely unqualified lead pool, and zero footfall had created a critical bottleneck in the sales pipeline.

Narrow Target Audience in a Tier-2 Market

Luxury buyers in Kota — HNIs, senior professionals, and NRIs — are a small, hard-to-reach segment. Traditional marketing wasn't cutting through. The brand needed a credibility boost and hyper-targeted digital reach to unlock this buyer pool.

Strategy by Digital Amnik
1

Hyper-Targeted Meta Ads

Precision audience targeting on Facebook & Instagram focused on HNIs, businessmen, senior govt. professionals, and Kota diaspora. Custom creatives showcasing luxury amenities and lifestyle positioning to attract serious buyers.

2

Influencer Marketing

Partnered with relevant local and regional influencers to build social proof and aspirational desire around the Gold Bellagio brand. Authentic content created trust among high-intent luxury buyers who were sitting on the fence.

3

Lead Quality Optimisation

Campaigns were continuously refined to maximise lead quality, not just volume. Achieved an industry-beating CPL of just ₹500, ensuring the sales team spent time only on genuinely interested, qualified prospects.

4

Sales Funnel Acceleration

A structured follow-up system was deployed to nurture all 450+ leads — from initial inquiry to site visit to booking. WhatsApp sequences, personalised communication, and regular sales pipeline reviews kept conversion velocity high.

5

Navratri Festive Offer — Creating Hype at the Right Moment

We strategically leveraged the Navratri festive season by launching exclusive limited-time offers tied to the occasion. This was amplified through influencer marketing — creators promoted the festive deal with high-energy content that generated urgency and aspirational desire simultaneously. The combination of a compelling offer, cultural timing, and influencer reach created a powerful hype cycle that drove a surge in high-intent inquiries and site visits during the campaign's peak window.

Impact for the Developer

Inventory movement restarted — after a slow phase, Digital Amnik's campaign injected fresh momentum and helped KGV Infra close 6 high-value units within 90 days.

Brand positioned as Kota's #1 ultra-luxury address — consistent premium messaging across Meta and influencer content elevated Gold Bellagio's perception among the city's elite.

Highly cost-efficient pipeline — at ₹500 CPL, the campaign delivered exceptional ROI for a luxury real estate product, with every lead being a qualified, high-intent buyer.

New digital-first benchmark set — Gold Bellagio's success proved that ultra-luxury real estate in Tier-2 cities can be effectively marketed and sold through precision digital campaigns.

Despite operating in a niche luxury segment in a Tier-2 market, Digital Amnik's data-driven Meta Ads and influencer strategy successfully revived Gold Bellagio's sales pipeline — generating 450+ leads, closing 6 units, and achieving ₹6.5 Crore in revenue within just 3 months. This case study is proof that the right digital strategy can unlock any market.
